_comment: Editorial layer over the generated what's-new page. See CONVENTIONS.md.
'entries' tunes generated cvar/command rows by name: hide, promote, summary, group.
An unknown name here is a hard error, so the file cannot rot when a cvar is renamed.
'features' carries additions that are not cvar-shaped and so cannot be generated.
A feature moves out of this file once its page exists and declares whats_new in
front matter; until then the build warns about the unresolved destination.
Seed summaries are provisional and must be verified against source when the page

features.title: .oshader override shaders
features.summary: Shader overrides loaded from shaders/*.oshader, parsed after every .shader file so they win without editing the originals.

features.title: Cosmetics custom offsets
features.summary: Per-model and per-skin position offsets for hats and capes, described by a JSON file shipped alongside the cosmetic.

features.title: Modifier and side-specific binds
features.summary: Bind ctrl/alt/shift key combinations, and bind the right-side modifier keys separately from the left.

features.title: Widescreen levelshots
features.summary: Levelshots authored for widescreen displays, loaded from levelshots_16_9 in preference to the 4:3 originals.

features.title: Tribes movement mode
features.summary: An experimental movement mode with skiing, a jetpack, class and pack selection, and its own HUD.

features.title: taystJKinfo feature flags
features.summary: A serverinfo key letting any server mod advertise which TaystJK client features it supports.
